questions.question: What does "schedule" mean in "My schedule is full on Tuesday"?
options: My plan of activities and times is full
questions.answer: My plan of activities and times is full
questions.explanation: Schedule là lịch trình, kế hoạch thời gian.

questions.question: Could you take the ______ at today's meeting? (biên bản)
questions.explanation: Minutes là biên bản cuộc họp.

questions.question: Which word means "a file sent together with an email"?
"We are over budget" means:
options: We have spent more money than planned
questions.answer: We have spent more money than planned
questions.explanation: Đã chi nhiều hơn ngân sách dự kiến.

questions.question: "Escalate" means to pass a problem to a more senior person.
questions.explanation: Escalate là chuyển vấn đề lên cấp cao hơn.

questions.question: I am writing to ______ our meeting on Monday. (xác nhận)
questions.explanation: Confirm = xác nhận một sự việc đã được sắp xếp.

questions.question: Read: "The office will close at 5 p.m. today because of a staff event." When does the office close today?
questions.explanation: Thông báo nêu rõ đóng cửa lúc 5 giờ chiều.

questions.question: Read: "Please submit your expense forms by the 25th. Late forms will be paid next month." What happens to late forms?
questions.explanation: Biểu mẫu nộp trễ sẽ được thanh toán vào tháng sau.

questions.question: Read: "We apologize for the delay and will send a replacement within 3 days." The company will send a replacement.
questions.explanation: Công ty sẽ gửi sản phẩm thay thế trong 3 ngày.

questions.question: "I would appreciate it if you could reply by Friday." The writer wants:
options: A reply before or on Friday
questions.answer: A reply before or on Friday
questions.explanation: Người viết muốn nhận phản hồi trước hoặc vào thứ Sáu.

questions.question: (Transcript) "The meeting is at ten thirty in Room B." What time is the meeting?
(Transcript) "We finished the design on time, but testing will take longer than planned." The testing is on schedule.
questions.explanation: Phần kiểm thử sẽ lâu hơn dự kiến nên không đúng tiến độ.

questions.question: Write 3-4 sentences to invite a colleague to a meeting tomorrow at 9 a.m.
questions.answer: Dear Minh, I would like to invite you to a meeting tomorrow at 9 a.m. in Room 2. We will discuss the new project. Please let me know if you can join. Best regards, Lan
questions.explanation: Bài tốt có lời chào, lời mời, thời gian, chủ đề và yêu cầu phản hồi.

questions.question: A customer received a damaged product. Write a short reply (60-100 words): apologize, offer a solution, and explain the next step.
questions.answer: Dear Mr. Park, I am very sorry that your product arrived damaged. We will send you a replacement free of charge. Please reply with a photo of the damage, and we will ship the new item within three days. Thank you for your patience. Kind regards, Support Team
questions.explanation: Bài tốt có lời xin lỗi, giải pháp rõ ràng và bước tiếp theo cụ thể.

questions.question: Say 3 sentences about your job or your major.
questions.answer: My name is Lan. I study business administration at a university in Ho Chi Minh City. I want to work in marketing in the future.
questions.explanation: Trả lời đủ ý, rõ ràng, đúng ngữ pháp cơ bản.

questions.question: A customer calls to complain about a late delivery. Respond politely and offer help.
questions.answer: Hello, thank you for calling. I am sorry for the delay. Let me check your order right now and find out what happened. I will also offer you a discount for the inconvenience.
questions.explanation: Câu trả lời tốt có lời xin lỗi, hành động cụ thể và giọng điệu lịch sự.
